what: The craft doctrine every video tool cites: how any video is read, written, shot and cut. Brand, product, avatar, model and platform free.
rule: This is the default language of craft for every video. The swipe's own read wins over a default, and VIDEO-RULINGS wins over this file. Model-specific wording lives in the model inputs, never here.

shot_language.rule: Name every shot by how close it is, the angle, how much the lens sees and how the camera moves. Size sets how close the viewer feels: wide gives facts, close gives feeling.

rows.name: Wide
rows.job: The room and where everyone stands

rows.name: Full
rows.job: Head to toe; body and clothes read

rows.name: Medium
rows.job: Waist up; talk and hands

rows.name: Two-shot
rows.job: Two people; the relationship

rows.name: Close-up
rows.job: A face or object; a thought changes

rows.name: Extreme close-up
rows.job: One detail; texture or proof

rows.name: Eye level
rows.job: Equal; a person talking to you

rows.name: Low angle
rows.job: Power or size

rows.name: High angle
rows.job: Small, watched or overwhelmed

rows.name: Overhead
rows.job: Hands, surfaces, steps of a process

rows.name: Odd angle
rows.job: Stops the scroll; use with a reason

rows.name: 24mm
rows.job: Sees more; stretches faces up close

rows.name: 35mm
rows.job: Natural scene default

rows.name: 50mm
rows.job: Neutral

rows.name: 85mm
rows.job: Flattering face; soft background

rows.name: Shallow focus
rows.job: Points the eye at one thing

rows.name: Deep focus
rows.job: Keeps the room in play

rows.name: Locked-off
rows.job: Still; the action carries it

rows.name: Handheld
rows.job: Phone-in-hand presence

rows.name: Push-in
rows.job: Tension or attention rises

rows.name: Pull-out
rows.job: A reveal or release

rows.name: Pan or tilt
rows.job: Follows or finds something

rows.name: Tracking
rows.job: Moves with a person

rows.name: Whip
rows.job: Fast energy; hides a cut

look.rule: Name where the light comes from, its quality, and the colors in frame. Never write a mood word the camera cannot photograph.

rows.name: Source and side
rows.job: Window left, overhead strip, ring light, phone screen

rows.name: Hard or soft
rows.job: Soft flatters; hard adds edge and drama

rows.name: Time of day
rows.job: Sets color and believability

rows.name: Palette line
rows.job: Two to four named colors per scene, kept across shots

rows.name: Planned shift
rows.job: A color change marks a story change

staging.rule: Say who stands where, who moves, and what must match from shot to shot. A wardrobe, prop or position that changes without a story reason is a defect.

rows.name: Positions
rows.job: Who is where in the room at the start of the shot

rows.name: Eyelines
rows.job: Where each person looks

rows.name: One clear move
rows.job: One action per shot, with its start and end

rows.name: Wardrobe
rows.job: Same clothes in wides and close-ups

rows.name: Props
rows.job: Same object, size, state and hand

rows.name: Screen direction
rows.job: People stay on their side and keep moving the same way

rows.name: Light match
rows.job: Same light direction through a scene

cutting.rule: Every cut gives something new: new information, a reaction, or a new size. Cut when the point lands. Sound is planned with the picture, never added as an afterthought.

rows.name: New information
rows.job: No shot outstays its point

rows.name: Size change
rows.job: Move between sizes to refresh the eye

rows.name: Reaction
rows.job: The listener's face carries the beat

rows.name: Pace by stakes
rows.job: Tightest before the product and the ask

rows.name: Ambient
rows.job: The room tone that makes it real

rows.name: Effects
rows.job: Named sounds tied to on-screen actions

rows.name: Voice
rows.job: Always on top of everything else

rows.name: Music
rows.job: Say if there is none; silence is a choice

consistency.rule: Decide once, on paper, then every shot copies the paper. Animation studios work this way, and it applies to every generated video.

rows.name: Model sheet
rows.job: One locked reference per character, attached to every shot

rows.name: Style line
rows.job: One written look, pasted word for word into every shot

rows.name: Look test
rows.job: One approved test frame before a run

rows.name: Color plan
rows.job: Palette per scene, set up front

rows.name: Set sheet
rows.job: One locked version of each location

rows.name: Boards
rows.job: Start pictures approved before motion

shapes.rule: These are defaults by format from the format bank. A format is a choice, never a house style; read the row that matches this video and ignore the rest. Short drama is one row among many. Script and production formats are named separately.

rows.cutting: Cut on thoughts; size changes replace b-roll gaps

shot_brief.rule: Every shot fills these lines. A blank line means the model picks for you. Say what the camera sees and hears; skip words you could not photograph. Write each prompt as if the model has seen nothing else, and change one thing per retry.

lines.asks: Each person and object, bound to its reference
The set, bound to its reference, and the time
